Manage connection endpoints for Windows 11 Enterprise

This is a synthetic fixture built for unit testing the WindowsEndpointParser module. It mirrors the structural shape of the real Microsoft Learn endpoint table — grouped areas, an area header/link row with a blank Protocol, continuation rows with blank Area/Description cells, inline formatting tags, and HTML entities — without being a verbatim copy of the live page.

Area Description Protocol Destination
Windows Insider Program Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for Windows Insider Program.
Used to preview and provide feedback on upcoming Windows builds. TCP 443 *.insider.windows.com
TCP 443 tsfe.insider.trafficshaping.dsp.mp.microsoft.com
Windows Update Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for Windows Update.
Used to scan, download, and install operating system & app updates from Windows Update. See endpoint guidance for details. TCP 443 definitionupdates.microsoft.com
TCP 443 *.prod.do.dsp.mp.microsoft.com
TCP 443 *.dl.delivery.mp.microsoft.com
TCP 443 *.windowsupdate.com
TCP 443 *.delivery.mp.microsoft.com
TCP 443 *.update.microsoft.com

Windows Update for Business Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for Windows Update for Business.
Used to deliver update deferral policies for Windows Update for Business. TCP 443 *.wub.microsoft.com
Device authentication Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for device authentication.
Used to authenticate the device when it accesses the Windows Update service. TCP 443 login.live.com*
TCP 443 *.login.microsoftonline.com
Microsoft Account Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for Microsoft Account.
Used to sign in with a Microsoft account, required for some update and store scenarios. TCP 443 account.microsoft.com
TCP 443 *.accountalt.azureedge.net
Certificate Trust Learn how to turn off traffic to all of the following endpoints for Certificate Trust.
Used for certificate revocation checks. TCP 80 *.digicert.com
